title: Fix hardware RT readback and shadow enum probing
objective: Repair the hardware ray tracing flashlight changes before user runtime testing. Fix examples/flashlight/run.py so try_read_console_variable_int treats SPEAR console variable handles of None and 0/falsy as missing before calling get_console_variable_value_as_int. Add regression tests where find_console_variable_by_name returns 0 for a requested hardware RT CVar and runtime readback reports unsupported/missing without crashing. Adjust examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py ray-traced spotlight shadow intent probing so explicit enabled enum/string/integer candidates are preferred before bool, include exact likely Unreal method/property spellings such as SetCastRaytracedShadows and CastRaytracedShadows if absent, and add tests for enum-valued fake setters/properties so applied does not mean UseProjectSetting. Rerun python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation and py_compile for changed Python files. Base the work on Inspector result .control-tower/packets/inbox/inspector-9c28c9d9-hardware-rt-review-result.json and preserve existing behavior outside realistic live hardware RT.
expected_outputs: Patched hardware RT readback and ray-traced shadow probing with regression coverage.
definition_of_done: Unit tests pass and py_compile passes for changed Python files.
